title: Scenario:
prompt: **Scenario:** Your validation loss is consistently *lower* than your training loss. Give 4 legitimate reasons why this occurs (e.g., strong Dropout/Augmentation active during training but disabled in eval; training loss averaged *across* the epoch while validation loss is measured *at the end* of the epoch; regularization terms added to training loss log but excluded from validation loss; validation set is easier/leaked).
